compliance screening is live in ampersend. agents paying for APIs and services over x402 move funds autonomously, and teams operating in regulated environments need those payments checked against sanctions and risk data before money moves. ampersend now handles that natively.

once enabled, every x402 payment runs through @trmlabs screening before settlement. the counterparty wallet gets checked against TRM's risk intelligence, covering sanctioned entities and flagged addresses, and settlement only proceeds on a clean result. flagged payments stop before funds leave the wallet. screening happens inline, without a separate review queue slowing settlement.

it's opt-in, configured per account, and runs within the payment flow, so agents keep their speed while every transaction stays within policy.
